metadata.cone_axis_convention: Mounting plane toward magnet; cone outward-air-normal projection is positive. Motion toward horn is along negative local z.

interface.notes: Artificial port surface joins canonical horn-cut perimeter to P. Boundary is exact; fan interior is an interface approximation, not the exact curved horn patch. Whole physical tube retained.

checks.surface_self_intersection_test: Not yet performed; canonical walls plus star-shaped cap are constructed without a global intersection certification.

metadata.diaphragm: Analytical conical surrogate tessellated at canonical rim angles. Active radius sqrt(Sd/pi); no measured dust cap or surround shape. Outside active radius is stationary mounting annulus.
metadata.differences_from_editor_volume: Canonical tube starts at curved horn-cut perimeter; editor neck air uses a flat nominal length. Cone closure is polygonal whereas editor cone volume is analytical. Interface star fan is declared rather than hidden.
metadata.losses: Geometry export only: no viscous/thermal loss or acoustic accuracy claim.
